minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  June 03, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:48 a.m.

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Wanda Brown, Treasure’s Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Micah Herd, Police Department

1. The minutes of May 13, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Enterprise Rent-A-Car - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $1,798.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. Josephson Institute - A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $2,750.00. Motion carried unanimously.

4. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:53 a.m.

Adjournment
